cohort: The study analyzed data on pregnancies delivered in 2020 and 2021 from the west and central regions of Norway, focusing on non-smoking women using snuff and comparing with mothers who smoked daily.
finding: Daily snuff use throughout the last trimester significantly reduced median gestational length by 3.4 days and median term birth weight by 44 g, an effect less pronounced than that of daily cigarette smoking.
gest_age: N/A (gestational length was an outcome, with specific analyses for birth weight performed on term births (39-41 weeks))
